authentication.secret: Base64 text representing 32 random bytes; use that text as the UTF-8 HMAC key, without Base64 decoding.
authentication.canonical:
METHOD
PATH
CANONICAL_QUERY
TIMESTAMP
NONCE
SHA256_RAW_BODY_HEX
API_KEY
authentication.query: Decode once; reject invalid percent/UTF-8 encoding and duplicate decoded keys; RFC3986 encode and sort encoded keys; space is %20.

getCityTaxDeclarations.name: getCityTaxDeclarations

apid.description: Property ID belonging to the authenticated account.

id.description: Source-qualified opaque declaration identity, not a numeric database ID.

status.description: Exact source status: do not collapse submitted, paid and settled states.

getCityTaxDeclarations.description: Read city-tax declarations with their local PDF in document as base64 JSON, or null when no local PDF is available.
businessRules: Search both declaration sources automatically; source is a response field, not a request filter. uniqid searches both sources; use the returned source-qualified id to select one unambiguously. Month and quarter are mutually exclusive and require year. Conflicting declaration identities must be rejected.
Validate source-specific periods and states. iTaxas keeps its stored numeric month when historical periodicity is unknown.
Grouped declarations appear once and must include the requested property. Never expose municipal credentials or internal error text.
Returns declarations, limit, offset and has_more. Each declaration contains document: {content_base64, content_type, filename} for an available local TMTAI PDF, otherwise null.

document_available is distinct from document_supported. Remote iTaxas documents are not fetched and token URLs are never returned. Invalid local PDF content returns invalid_document. Local files are bounded at 50 MiB; delivery additionally requires the page to fit 60 MiB of encoded document JSON, below the 64 MiB HTTP ceiling. An oversized page, including an individual PDF too large after Base64 encoding, returns HTTP 413 response_too_large. Use an identity or a smaller limit for multi-document pages.
A source-qualified identity lookup rejects duplicate identities and returns not_found when no declaration matches.

id.description: Source-qualified opaque declaration identity, not a numeric database ID.

source.description: Declaration source; part of its identity.

uniqid.description: Opaque declaration identity from the selected source.
